race.comment: Good little race and keen to side with the Michael Freedman-trained WANDA'S SPARK (7), a well-bred filly who ran out a good winner at Canterbury last time out, leading and showing plenty of grit at just her second start. She'd chased a good one on debut and looks set to improve again. FLEET FLYER (5) was a dominant winner first up at Wyong over 1100m, bolting away by five lengths. Drawn wide here but with any luck can push on and take beating again. ZOU ROYAL (8) won nicely as favourite last time at Canberra Acton and has claims in this tougher affair. GLASTONBURY GIRL (1) resumes and will want further but can sprint well fresh.
